settings.description: SS11.3 - the balanced alpha-mode allocation. The AC-count ladder showed the alpha channel is badly starved and that its coefficients are better bought from chroma than from luma, but its best arms drove luma or chroma to near-zero. This grid varies the alpha count and the chroma count together with luma filling the remainder, so the chosen point is a balance rather than a corner. Luma is held at 4 bits, matching the opaque tier-0 choice.
